dedupe_keys.name: code and data for publication decarbonizing the cement industry findings from coupling prospective life cycle assessment of clinker with integrated assessment model scenarios

description: Amelie Müller and colleagues publish Python code and data coupling future cement scenarios with prospective life-cycle assessment. Zenodo archives the package under BSD 3-Clause. The description separates primary and LCA analysis from construction of community scenarios for the premise tool. It converts future cement-production results from the IMAGE integrated assessment model into the format needed for clinker process assessment, then analyses outputs and draws publication figures. This workflow can compare clinker-production emissions under alternative industrial decarbonisation scenarios. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this cement-specific coupling package. Coverage is the study’s technology and scenario assumptions, not real-time emissions at cement plants. A limitation is that IMAGE, premise and background LCA database versions affect comparability and may have separate access terms. The paper is described as accepted in 2024, but current bibliographic status was not independently checked. The archive was not downloaded, code was not run and LCA results were not recalculated.
